subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap from our call and a proposal for next steps. I pulled this together so we have a short mutual action plan.

Key takeaways
- Volterra use case: customer-facing agent summarization and search for support tickets (~50k docs, PII present in some records)
- Priority: Q2 POC to evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs and integration complexity
- Success metrics: 95th-ile latency < 250ms for single-turn inferencing, < $0.002/token net in steady state, fidelity on ticket summaries ~NPS uplift

Mutual action plan (suggested)
1) Redwood technical deep-dive + demo (45m) — target week of Jan 25 — owner: Jasmine
2) Security questionnaire / SOC2 materials — Redwood to share baseline docs — owner: Jasmine (by Jan 18)
3) Initial POC scope & VM/ingest plan — draft by Volterra — owner: Liam/Priya (by Feb 4)
4) Procurement touchpoint (pricing outline attached) — owner: Jasmine/Volterra procurement (ASAP after demo)

Attachments: MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan) — attached.

Ask: Can you confirm the week that works for the demo and whether your procurement lead should be on the call? If you want, I can lock two slots on Jan 25/26 and we can pick one.

If I don't hear a confirmation by Friday I'll ping again with specific times.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: MAP-v1.pdf (1 page PDF)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@volterra.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.inc>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Thanks for the clear recap, Jasmine — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we lock the demo: 

1) Data residency: our legal team needs to confirm that logs and inference data can be restricted to US regions (we cannot push production data outside US). Will Redwood support a US-only processing option for the POC?

2) KMS: we need to understand key management options (bring-your-own-key is preferred). Do you have a short doc on KMS integrations?

3) SOC2: can you share the most recent SOC2 report or an attestation? If you can share the documents we can circulate them internally to speed procurement review.

I can make Jan 25 work for a demo — prefer afternoon PT. Priya will be the primary technical lead on our side.

Liam
Head of Product, Volterra AI
liam@volterra.ai | +1 (650) 555-1103
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@volterra.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.inc>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Great — thanks, Liam. Short answers below and I attached a pricing outline for the POC. 

1) Data residency: yes — Redwood can restrict processing to US regions for a POC. For Private deployments we support VPC/on-prem options; for Hosted we can route to our US-only region and include contractual language for data handling.
2) KMS: we support BYOK with KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). I attached a KMS summary in the pricing sheet and can loop in our security engineer for a quick 30m call if helpful.
3) SOC2: attaching an attestation and our security overview. If you need the full report, we can do an NDA-forwarded exchange or a secure sharing link — let me know which you prefer.

Demo slots: I blocked Jan 25 1pm PT and Jan 26 10am PT. Which do you prefer?

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing + KMS summary + security overview).

Next: if Jan 25 works I'll send a calendar invite and include Sean (our SE) for the architecture portion.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
